t: 百年战争快到尾声了 法国的攻击和几乎消灭了英国势力 结束了英国在法国北部的统治.
te: Toward the end of the Hundred Years' War, the French attack and nearly annihilate English forces, ending English domina…
dz: Formigny之战:百年战争快到尾声了 法国的攻击和几乎消灭了英国势力 结束了英国在法国北部的统治.
de: Battle of Formigny: Toward the end of the Hundred Years' War, the French attack and nearly annihilate English forces, ending English domination in Northern France.

t: 蒂穆里德君主'阿布德·拉蒂夫被暗杀.
dz: 蒂穆里德君主'阿布德·拉蒂夫被暗杀.

t: 一支庞大的奥斯曼部队开始包围克鲁杰的阿尔巴尼亚叛乱部队,最终会失败.
te: A large Ottoman force begins the siege of Albanian rebel forces in Krujë, that ultimately will fail.
dz: 一支庞大的奥斯曼部队开始包围克鲁杰的阿尔巴尼亚叛乱部队,最终会失败.
de: A large Ottoman force begins the siege of Albanian rebel forces in Krujë, that ultimately will fail.

t: 杰克·凯德和他的追随者不受亨利六世国王政府阻碍地进入了伦敦.
te: Jack Cade and his followers enter London unhindered by the government of king Henry VI.
dz: 杰克·凯德和他的追随者不受亨利六世国王政府阻碍地进入了伦敦.
de: Jack Cade and his followers enter London unhindered by the government of king Henry VI.

t: 虽然之前他已经被赦免了,但杰克·凯德在逃跑时被杀死了,结束了杰克·凯德的叛乱.
te: Although he had been previously pardoned, Jack Cade is killed while fleeing, bringing an end to Jack Cade's Rebellion.
dz: 虽然之前他已经被赦免了,但杰克·凯德在逃跑时被杀死了,结束了杰克·凯德的叛乱.
de: Although he had been previously pardoned, Jack Cade is killed while fleeing, bringing an end to Jack Cade's Rebellion.

t: 路易九世,巴伐利亚公爵将犹太人驱逐出他的管辖范围.
te: Louis IX, Duke of Bavaria expels Jews from his jurisdiction.
dz: 路易九世,巴伐利亚公爵将犹太人驱逐出他的管辖范围.
de: Louis IX, Duke of Bavaria expels Jews from his jurisdiction.
